_comment: Measured test seconds for CI's test shards (scripts/ci_test_shards.py): `modules` is each module's whole Test/test, `split` the suites of a module spread over the shards. A suite of a split module not named here shares what is left of its module's seconds with the other unnamed ones. Measured in the six shards of CI run 43629636860 (2026-11-14, ubuntu-24.04), each suite's time from the sbt log: tests run one suite at a time (build.sbt, `Test / parallelExecution`), and sbt writes a suite's lines when it ends. `node`'s total includes the cold start of each part it ran in there: split six ways it took 476 to 513 s in two sharded runs (43629636860, 43632138307), against 372 s as one module in `check`, and ledger took 123 to 128 s against 94 s. Other modules vary between runs by as much as the shards differ (plutus 150 s, then 90 s). `warts` was measured locally, not in CI: its three suites took 0.04 s in all (2026-11-15, in the JDK image), since their probes are typed when they compile, and 0.1 s stands for it.
